_comment: OPEN search, SYMMETRIC -3000/+3000 Da. POSITIVE CONTROL ONLY -- not the primary metric.
Sage's `da:[-a,+b]` bounds the CANDIDATE mass, so the reportable dm = expmass - calcmass spans
[-b,+a] -- the MIRROR of the written interval. The previous -3000/+1000 therefore reported
dm in [-1000,+3000], which DID cover the 4->2 artefact (k=+2, positive dm) that this control
targets. Measured rays in the envelope arm were {+2: 26, +1: 2, +3: 1} -- all positive k, and
+2 IS the 4->2 signature. The control fired: 26 observed vs 8.9 expected at base rate is a
Made symmetric so the OPPOSITE direction (2->4, k=-2, negative dm) is equally reportable.
That is a robustness change, not a bug fix: an asymmetric window makes recovery rates depend
on error direction, which would bias any sensitivity calibration run through it.
Expensive, and its target-decoy FDR is correspondingly less trustworthy -- which is why
entrapment rather than decoy is the FDR estimator here.
